tagline: Transform scattered memories into narrated visual stories

overview.description: An intelligent media analysis and storytelling application that transforms unorganized photos and videos into cohesive, narrated presentations. Users upload media files, provide optional creative direction, and receive a sequenced slideshow with downloadable narration scripts.
overview.primary_use_case: Converting personal media collections (travel footage, event photos, project documentation) into professional-quality presentations with synchronized narration text.

media_analysis.description: AI-powered analysis of uploaded images and videos
capabilities: Object and scene recognition (architecture, nature, people, activities)
Location identification via visual landmarks and metadata
Temporal sequencing using EXIF data and visual context clues
Mood and atmosphere detection (lighting, colors, energy)
Face detection for consistent person tracking across media
Video keyframe extraction for scene summarization

intelligent_organization.description: Context-aware sequencing based on user intent
capabilities: Thematic clustering (group by subject, location, or activity)
Chronological reconstruction when metadata is available
Narrative arc creation (beginning, development, climax, resolution)
Relevance filtering based on user prompt
Quality scoring to prioritize best shots
Historical and cultural context integration when relevant
Multiple narration style options per project

steps.name: Upload Media
steps.description: User uploads images and/or videos from their device or cloud storage

steps.name: Provide Creative Direction (Optional)
steps.description: User enters a prompt to guide the organization and narration style

prompt_field.label: What story do you want to tell?
prompt_field.placeholder: Example: Turn these images and videos from my trip to Peru in 2018 into a presentation focused on the ancient architecture I witnessed during my time there.

steps.name: Analysis & Processing
steps.description: App analyzes all uploaded media and generates organizational structure
processing_stages: Applying user prompt filters and priorities

steps.name: Review & Refine
steps.description: User reviews the proposed sequence and narration
interface_features: Side-by-side media preview and narration text

steps.name: Export & Download
steps.description: User downloads their organized presentation materials

user_input.media: 247 photos and 12 videos from Peru trip (2018)
user_input.prompt: Turn these images and videos from my trip to Peru in 2018 into a presentation focused on the ancient architecture I witnessed during my time there.

sequence_structure.title: Arrival in Lima
sequence_structure.narration_preview: My journey into Peru's architectural past began in Lima, where Spanish colonial buildings first hinted at the layers of history I was about to uncover...

sequence_structure.title: Sacred Valley Foundations
sequence_structure.narration_preview: The Sacred Valley revealed the genius of Incan engineering—terraces carved into mountainsides that have endured centuries...

sequence_structure.title: Machu Picchu: Crown Jewel
sequence_structure.narration_preview: Standing before Machu Picchu at sunrise, I understood why the Incas chose this impossible location. Every stone placed with intention...

user_input.media: 180 photos and 8 videos from wedding weekend
user_input.prompt: Create a chronological highlight reel of my daughter's wedding, focusing on emotional moments.

sequence_structure.title: Morning Preparations
sequence_structure.narration_preview: The day began with quiet anticipation...

user_input.media: 156 mixed photos from phone camera roll

ai_capabilities_needed: Large language model for narration generation
Embedding model for semantic similarity clustering

data_handling.privacy: All media processed locally or in secure cloud environment
data_handling.metadata_extraction: EXIF, GPS, timestamps preserved and utilized

performance_targets.analysis_speed: ~2 seconds per image, ~10 seconds per minute of video

user_goals: Transform forgotten media into shareable stories
Save hours of manual organization work
measurable_outcomes: Percentage of uploaded media successfully categorized
